valid_syntax.justification: AVG over one field value, over the full fixture population and over a three-record window parse, resolve and produce decimal results.

invalid_syntax.justification: Zero-argument and two-argument AVG are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: AVG ignores NULL inputs, propagates an all-NULL argument to NULL, produces exact terminating decimals and applies the ruled six-digit half-even rounding to non-terminating quotients.

types_and_null.justification: AVG over a text field is rejected as a type diagnostic; NULL inputs are skipped and an all-NULL argument yields NULL.

boundaries.justification: AVG over empty input yields a single NULL row, and the ruled rounding boundary (non-terminating quotient, half-even at six digits) is pinned normatively.

interactions.justification: AVG composes inside scalar wrappers (COALESCE with a NULL AVG taking the fallback, then scalar addition).

adversarial.justification: The rounding contract is exercised on a non-terminating quotient and verified against an independent oracle; the exact terminating decimal rules out float-noise contamination.

valid_syntax.justification: CARDINALITY over a collection field parses and resolves, counting NULL elements.

invalid_syntax.justification: Zero-argument and two-argument CARDINALITY are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: CARDINALITY counts NULL elements, propagates a NULL collection to NULL and yields zero for the empty collection.

types_and_null.justification: CARDINALITY over a scalar operand is rejected as a type diagnostic.

boundaries.justification: The empty and NULL collection boundaries are pinned.

interactions.justification: CARDINALITY composes over FILTER results.

adversarial.justification: CARDINALITY over a filtered collection with a predicate that matches a single tagged element is pinned.

valid_syntax.justification: CHAR over decimal, astral and integer-expression code points parses and resolves.

invalid_syntax.justification: Out-of-range, surrogate, negative, fractional and text code points are rejected.

semantics.justification: CHAR maps scalar values exactly (including astral planes), expands sharp s via UPPER afterwards, and propagates NULL.

types_and_null.justification: Text arguments are rejected; NULL arguments propagate to NULL in any position.

boundaries.justification: The Unicode scalar-value boundaries (0x10FFFF ceiling, surrogate exclusion) are pinned.

interactions.justification: CHAR composes inside LOWER, UPPER and LENGTH.

adversarial.justification: Computed code points that overflow the scalar range are rejected, and composed-accent construction is pinned as two code points.

valid_syntax.justification: COALESCE over constants and over a field with a fallback parses and resolves.

invalid_syntax.justification: Zero-argument and one-argument COALESCE are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: COALESCE returns the first non-NULL argument, treats zero and empty strings as non-NULL values, and propagates NULL when all arguments are NULL.

types_and_null.justification: The all-NULL result is NULL; a NULL field value takes the fallback.

boundaries.justification: Falsey-value boundaries (zero, empty string) are pinned as returned values.

interactions.justification: COALESCE composes over NULLIF, CONCAT, nested COALESCE and scalar arithmetic over fields.

adversarial.justification: COALESCE does not evaluate later arguments when an earlier one is non-NULL (division-by-zero guard pinned).

valid_syntax.justification: CONCAT over constants, fields and empty arguments parses and resolves in argument order.

invalid_syntax.justification: Non-text arguments are rejected as type diagnostics; zero-argument CONCAT is a syntax diagnostic.

semantics.justification: Any NULL argument propagates to NULL, in every argument position.

types_and_null.justification: Integer arguments are rejected as type diagnostics; NULL propagation is pinned per position.

boundaries.justification: Empty-string arguments concatenate as zero-width values.

interactions.justification: CONCAT composes inside LENGTH, nests UPPER/LOWER, and participates in NULL chains.

adversarial.justification: Multi-script, emoji and combining-mark concatenation is pinned byte-exactly, blocking normalising or lossy implementations.

valid_syntax.justification: COUNT(*) and COUNT over expressions, literals and collection bindings parse and resolve.

invalid_syntax.justification: Two-argument COUNT, text-argument COUNT and scalar-operand collection COUNT are rejected.

semantics.justification: COUNT(*) counts rows, expression COUNT skips NULLs, collection COUNT counts true predicate results including explicit NULL elements and references outer row fields.

types_and_null.justification: COUNT(NULL) is zero and collection COUNT over a scalar operand is a type diagnostic.

boundaries.justification: COUNT over empty input is zero and explicit NULL-element counting is a boundary shape.

interactions.justification: COUNT composes with GROUP BY, CTEs and aggregate FILTER applied per-aggregate after WHERE.

adversarial.justification: Nested aggregates and aggregate GROUP BY expressions are rejected, blocking runaway recursion shapes.

valid_syntax.justification: FILTER over a collection field with a predicate parses and resolves, including predicates that reference outer row fields.

invalid_syntax.justification: Zero-argument FILTER and the missing-AS binding form are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: FILTER keeps only true results in original order, distinguishes NULL from empty collections, keeps explicit NULL elements and references outer row fields.

types_and_null.justification: FILTER over a scalar operand is rejected as a type diagnostic.

boundaries.justification: The no-match and empty-collection boundaries are pinned.

interactions.justification: FILTER composes with CARDINALITY, MAP and indexing, in pipelines and standalone.

adversarial.justification: Explicit NULL-element retention and outer-field resolution are pinned against implementations that drop or mis-scope them.

valid_syntax.justification: GREATEST over numeric and text constants and over a field argument parses and resolves.

invalid_syntax.justification: One-argument and zero-argument GREATEST are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: GREATEST handles equal values, negatives, NULL propagation in either position and exact Unicode code-point ordering.

types_and_null.justification: Incompatible argument types are rejected as type diagnostics; any NULL argument propagates to NULL.

boundaries.justification: Equal-value and all-negative boundaries are pinned.

interactions.justification: Greatest composes with its opposite, nested, across aggregate results and in facet-join torture shapes.

adversarial.justification: Code-point ordering over composed, decomposed and sharp-s arguments is pinned exactly.

valid_syntax.justification: LEAST over numeric and text constants and over a field argument parses and resolves.

invalid_syntax.justification: One-argument and zero-argument LEAST are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: LEAST handles equal values, three-argument NULL propagation, signed integers and exact Unicode ordering.

types_and_null.justification: Incompatible argument types are rejected as type diagnostics; any NULL argument propagates to NULL.

boundaries.justification: Equal-value and signed-integer boundaries are pinned.

interactions.justification: Least composes with its opposite, nested, over field arguments and in facet-join torture shapes.

adversarial.justification: Code-point ordering over composed, decomposed and sharp-s arguments is pinned exactly.

valid_syntax.justification: LENGTH over constants and committed fixture titles (composed and decomposed) parses and resolves to integer counts.

invalid_syntax.justification: Zero-argument and two-argument LENGTH forms are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: LENGTH counts code points across scripts, emoji, ZWJ families, and propagates NULL.

types_and_null.justification: LENGTH over a numeric field is rejected as a type diagnostic; NULL arguments propagate to NULL.

boundaries.justification: Empty strings, regional-indicator pairs, combining marks and composed/decomposed accents are boundary shapes with pinned counts.

interactions.justification: LENGTH composes inside LENGTH(CONCAT(...)), LENGTH(CHAR(...)) and NULL chains; aggregate-context LENGTH composition is recorded under MIN and MAX.

adversarial.justification: Grapheme-deceptive shapes (ZWJ families, flag pairs, composed versus decomposed accents) are pinned as code-point counts, blocking grapheme-cluster implementations.

valid_syntax.justification: LOWER over constants, Greek sigma forms and committed fixture titles (including Turkish dotted I) parse and resolve to case-folded results.

invalid_syntax.justification: Zero-argument, two-constant-argument and field-pair LOWER forms are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: Case folding covers mixed-case ASCII, sharp s, Turkish dotted I, the Kelvin sign, and NULL propagation.

types_and_null.justification: LOWER over a numeric field is rejected as a type diagnostic; NULL arguments propagate to NULL.

boundaries.justification: Empty strings, digit-only and punctuation-only arguments are boundary shapes with pinned results.

interactions.justification: LOWER composes inside LENGTH, inside UPPER(CONCAT(...)) and alongside UPPER inside CONCAT.

adversarial.justification: Locale-sensitive and expansion-sensitive folding shapes (final sigma, sharp s, dotted I) are pinned exactly, blocking naive ASCII fold implementations.

valid_syntax.justification: MAP over a collection field with a SELECT projection parses and resolves, including outer-row references in the projection.

invalid_syntax.justification: Zero-argument MAP, missing binding, missing SELECT and aggregate projections are rejected.

semantics.justification: MAP projects each element in order, preserves NULL elements in position, distinguishes NULL from empty collections and can be indexed after projection.

types_and_null.justification: Scalar operands and aggregate projections are rejected as type diagnostics.

boundaries.justification: The NULL-versus-empty and post-projection indexing boundaries are pinned.

interactions.justification: MAP composes with FILTER, CARDINALITY and pipelines in both orders, with outer-row visibility preserved.

adversarial.justification: NULL-element position preservation and fused-pipeline outer-row visibility are pinned against lossy implementations.

valid_syntax.justification: MAX over a field, a single record and an arithmetic expression parses and resolves.

invalid_syntax.justification: Zero-argument and two-argument MAX are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: MAX propagates an all-NULL argument to NULL and orders text exactly by code points.

types_and_null.justification: All-NULL MAX is NULL; the text-argument rejection family is pinned for SUM/AVG.

boundaries.justification: MAX over empty input is NULL; the population maximum boundary is pinned.

interactions.justification: MAX composes inside GREATEST across aggregates, over LENGTH and with arithmetic.

adversarial.justification: Code-point text extrema and arithmetic-expression arguments are pinned.

valid_syntax.justification: MIN over a field, a single record and an arithmetic expression parses and resolves.

invalid_syntax.justification: Zero-argument and two-argument MIN are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: MIN propagates an all-NULL argument to NULL and computes the population minimum.

types_and_null.justification: All-NULL MIN is NULL; text arguments are rejected for SUM/AVG (MIN accepts text and orders it).

boundaries.justification: MIN over empty input is NULL; the population minimum boundary is pinned.

interactions.justification: MIN composes inside GREATEST across aggregates and with arithmetic.

adversarial.justification: The population minimum boundary and arithmetic-expression arguments are pinned.

valid_syntax.justification: NULLIF over unequal constants and over field arguments parses and resolves.

invalid_syntax.justification: One-, three- and zero-argument NULLIF are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: NULLIF yields NULL on true equality in every NULL arrangement.

types_and_null.justification: Incompatible argument types are rejected as type diagnostics; NULL arguments propagate.

boundaries.justification: Empty-string and equal-text boundaries are pinned.

interactions.justification: NULLIF composes with COALESCE in both orders, nested, and inside NULL chains.

adversarial.justification: NULLIF compares exact code points without normalisation: composed and decomposed accents are unequal.

valid_syntax.justification: POSITION projection over ascending, descending, paginated and CTE-nested query blocks parses and resolves.

invalid_syntax.justification: POSITION is rejected outside a standalone final projection: argument shapes, ORDER BY dependence, WHERE, ORDER BY clauses, arithmetic, grouping and nesting.

semantics.justification: POSITION numbers the final result after DISTINCT and aggregation, across groups, without ordering, over sliced derived relations and surviving outer reordering.

types_and_null.justification: POSITION in set-operation projections is rejected as unsupported in both arms.

boundaries.justification: Empty results, pagination windows and the OFFSET/LIMIT boundary over a tied-order window are pinned.

interactions.justification: POSITION interacts with CTEs, derived tables, slices and set operations with defined scoping.

adversarial.justification: DESC-ordered pagination windows with continued numbering, and the alias-ordering rejection, are pinned.

valid_syntax.justification: Seeded RANDOM over several (seed, record) pairs parses and resolves, with values pinned under the ruled derivation.

invalid_syntax.justification: Two-argument RANDOM is rejected as a syntax diagnostic.

semantics.justification: Seeded RANDOM orders deterministically, equals itself per record within one execution, and unseeded RANDOM preserves the complete window.

types_and_null.justification: All five volatile placements (WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, aggregate FILTER, JOIN ON) are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

boundaries.justification: The [0, 1) value range is pinned for seeded and unseeded calls through volatility-unobservable predicates.

interactions.justification: Seeded randomness coexists with aggregation and ORDER BY deterministically.

adversarial.justification: Large seeds and the per-record determinism contract are pinned, blocking time-based or shared-state implementations.

valid_syntax.justification: SUM over a field, a single record and an arithmetic expression parses and resolves.

invalid_syntax.justification: Zero-argument and two-argument SUM are rejected as syntax diagnostics.

semantics.justification: SUM ignores NULL inputs, sums integers exactly and propagates an all-NULL argument to NULL.

types_and_null.justification: SUM over a text field is rejected as a type diagnostic; NULL inputs are skipped.

boundaries.justification: SUM over empty input is NULL and arithmetic-expression arguments are pinned.

interactions.justification: SUM composes with aggregate FILTER applied per-aggregate after WHERE, over a window with a NULL duration row.

adversarial.justification: Integer exactness is pinned over a 22-record window with NULLs, blocking float accumulation drift.

valid_syntax.justification: UPPER over constants and committed fixture titles (German sharp s expansion) parses and resolves.

invalid_syntax.justification: Zero-argument, two-argument and numeric-field UPPER forms are rejected (syntax and type diagnostics respectively).

semantics.justification: Uppercasing covers ASCII, digit invariance, NULL propagation and the German sharp-s expansion to SS.

types_and_null.justification: UPPER over a numeric field is rejected as a type diagnostic; NULL arguments propagate to NULL.

boundaries.justification: Empty strings and digit-only arguments are boundary shapes with pinned results.

interactions.justification: UPPER composes inside UPPER(CONCAT(LOWER(...))), inside LENGTH and inside MAP projections.

adversarial.justification: The sharp-s expansion (one code point to two) is pinned exactly, blocking case-mapping implementations that map one-to-one.
